title: Relax in music city 3BR | Rooftop | Movie Theater
description:
Hi Y’all! Come experience Nashville in this large private home with a MOVIE THEATER, GAME ROOM & ROOFTOP in East Nashville only 2 miles from Broadway

Included in your stay:
★ 3 Rooms, 3.5 bathrooms 
★ 10 Beds
★ Fully Equipped Kitchen with Coffee & Tea
★ Movie & Game Room with 100" Screen
★ Rooftop with TV, Hammock, sitting area and sun shade chairs
★ 4 Smart TVs
★ Speedy WiFi 
★ PS4 with games
★ Corn Hole, Connect 4, Arcade games, Board games
★ Disney+/Hulu/Netflix
★ Washer/Dryer
★ WFH desk

The space
This private, three-story with Rooftop, 2300 sqft. home has been carefully crafted for every type of traveler.

★★★★ ENTRY FLOOR ★★★★

Behind the secure, keyless lock to your left, you will find the first bedroom with ♛ 2 Full Beds and an ensuite Bath. 

Continue straight and enter your private HUGE home Theater and game room!

★ The Private Theater room is equipped with:

☆ 100" Movie Screen with Surround Sound
☆ 8 Reclining Theater Seats
☆ Access to Netflix / Disney+ / Amazon Prime / Hulu / YouTube and many other live-stream applications and TV games
☆ Beer-Pong Table
☆ PlayStation 4 with many video games
☆ Arcade games
☆ Huge selection of board games including Giant Janja, Sorry, Monopoly, Clue, Wits and Wagers, and MANY MORE
☆ Corn hole, Giant Connect 4, Wall ring toss game
☆2 high tables with 4 chairs 
☆ Electric Fireplace Heater
☆ Cooler to store your drinks
☆ Cool Neon lights 

☆☆☆☆ NOTE ☆☆☆☆
The Theater room is in a converted garage that was not retrofitted with AC. However, we provide an electric fan if needed. Please take this into account when booking.

★★★★ FIRST FLOOR ★★★★

Take a stroll up the authentic hardwood stair set where you will find yourself in the spacious living room/kitchen combo welcoming you with:

★ Comfortable Seating for 8
★ Smart TV with Disney+, Hulu, Netflix and Cable TV
★ Cookware, Toaster, Keurig & Coffee
★ Wine Glasses, Shot Glasses & Dinnerware
★ 2 Queen Sofa beds

★★★★ SECOND FLOOR ★★★★

Take a trip (not literally) up the stairs to the second floor where you will find:

♛ Queen Suite Room - 2 Queen Beds, Ensuite large Bath, WFH Desk and Ergonomic chair, Smart TV
♛ Royal King Room - King Bed, Ensuite Bath, Smart TV
★ Laundry Room with Washer & Dryer

★★★★ ROOFTOP ★★★★

Take another quick hike to your Amazing Rooftop. Behind the door you’ll find:

★ Comfortable Outdoor seating set with tables
★ Hammock to relax
★ 2 Sunshade chairs and 2 beach chairs to sit and enjoy downtown Nashville Skyline view
★ Outdoor TV
★ Smoking Area

Experience luxury and comfort Scenic rooftop deck, ideal for unwinding after a long day of exploring the city.

*** If more sleeping space is required, there are 3 comfortable rollout beds and an air mattress that can be found in closets. Additionally, the 2 sofa beds in the living room can be made into beds.

Guest access
The home is exclusively yours, without interruption, for the duration of your stay, so relax, unwind, and make yourself at home. Access to the unit is keyless with a code that will be provided to you 24 hours before you check in.

Other things to note
★ No Unapproved Pets Allowed ★
★ No Smoking Inside House ★
★ No Parties/Events ★

★★★★ Parking ★★★★

Parking for this unit can be parallel to the unit's garage door. In addition, there is plenty of ample street parking. We ask guests NOT to park in the driveway and NOT to block other units' garages

★★★★ GREAT FOR LARGE GROUPS ★★★★
We own the whole complex. There are 5 side by side large beautiful NEW townhomes with the capability of holding up to 50 guests. Each house has 3 bedrooms and 3.5 baths. 2 of the units have movie theaters. We have accommodation that can fit any group size, so please inquire and we will find the best option for you!
